items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember that you told me about Erroll Garner when he came to St. Louis, and I went to hear him.

ctx.x: I first heard Erroll Garner when I was at Rockaway Beach, Missouri. I remember liking an Erroll Garner record there.
I remember that you told me about Erroll Garner when he came to St. Louis, and I went to hear him.

Well, after that, you went to Lafayette, Louisiana, and you got a three-week job there. Then the trio broke up. Then you went to Panama City, Florida, and you took a job there, and stuff happened. You played trumpet and piano, and the pianist Walter Norris was also playing piano—who would wind up playing with Ornette Coleman on his first record, and settled in Europe, and was a first-class jazz concert pianist.
